name: Low Gravity
_help: gravityScale: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half gravity. jumpScale shrinks the jump so it stays floaty instead of sky-high. shipResponse: how fast the ship reaches full speed (higher = snappier, 0 = never). Brawler uses the platformer settings; launched enemies hang in the air longer, so juggles get easy. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine once reached; each can change any setting above plus description, payout (and minimum on Collector/Killer).
